title: "Nonlinear Dynamics — Strogatz"

**Text.** Steven Strogatz, *Nonlinear Dynamics and Chaos*.

**Mode.** Browse-driven; low-energy day substitute for the primary text. Pick a chapter when curious — fixed points, bifurcations, phase portraits, chaos.

**Why.** Physical intuition for dynamical systems; counterweight to pure formalism. Many concepts (stability, attractors, sensitivity) translate directly into how to read PK/PD and ODE-driven models.
